# netbox_export_template (Resource)

A Jinja2 export template for the object types it applies to (extras.exporttemplate).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/extras/exporttemplate/):

> Export templates are used to render arbitrary data from a set of NetBox objects. For example, you might want to automatically generate a network monitoring service configuration from a list of device objects. See the [export templates documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/customization/export-templates/) for more information.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_export_template" "test" {
  name           = "test-export-template"
  object_types   = ["dcim.device"]
  template_code  = "{% for obj in queryset %}{{ obj.name }}\n{% endfor %}"
  mime_type      = "text/csv"
  file_name      = "test-file"
  file_extension = "csv"
  as_attachment  = true
  description    = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the template can export, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `template_code` (String) Jinja2 template code; the queryset is available as {{ queryset }}.

### Optional

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download the rendered output as a file instead of displaying it.
- `description` (String)
- `environment_params` (String) Parameters for the Jinja2 environment as JSON text (use jsonencode()).
- `file_extension` (String) Extension appended to the file name, e.g. csv.
- `file_name` (String) File name of the rendered output, without extension.
- `mime_type` (String) MIME type of the rendered output, e.g. text/csv.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_export_template.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_export_template.test 123
```
